front: Fastest Spark session start with no sizing work
back: Starter pool: pre-warmed Medium nodes, sessions usually start in seconds. Custom pool không phải live pool thì start khoảng 3 phút.

front: Workspace admin cannot create a custom Spark pool
back: A capacity admin must enable Customized workspace pools in the capacity Spark Compute settings. Setting này mặc định bật.

front: Custom Spark pool node sizes and limits
back: Small 4 vCores/32 GB to XX-Large 64 vCores/512 GB; max 200 nodes; autopause after 2 minutes idle. Single node (min 1) được hỗ trợ.

front: Environment: Quick mode vs Full mode
back: Quick: publish in about 5 seconds, libraries install at session start. Full: 3 to 6 minute publish, stable snapshot for pipelines and scheduled runs. Resources không cần publish.

ref.label: Create, configure, and use an environment

front: High concurrency session sharing conditions
back: Same user, same default lakehouse, same Spark compute settings, same library packages. Chỉ activity khởi tạo session bị tính compute.

ref.label: High concurrency for notebooks in pipelines

front: Notebooks per high concurrency session
back: Default 5; raise up to 50 with spark.highConcurrency.max in the environment Spark properties. Pipeline gom notebook theo session tag.

front: Autotune limitations
back: Preview, off by default, Runtime 1.2 only, not with high concurrency or private endpoint, skips queries under 15 seconds. Bật bằng spark.ms.autotune.enabled=true.

front: Stop runaway user Spark jobs in a workspace
back: Jobs > Set maximum job lifetime. Job hệ thống như optimize, vacuum, materialized lake view refresh không bị huỷ.

front: Who assigns a workspace to a domain from workspace settings
back: A domain contributor who is Admin of that workspace. Domain không đổi ai được access item.

front: Reduce egress cost for repeated reads through S3 or GCS shortcuts
back: Workspace settings > OneLake > shortcut cache, retention 1 to 28 days. File trên 1 GB không được cache.

front: Apache Airflow job pool for production DAGs
back: Custom pool: always on until paused, autoscale, extra nodes (each adds 3 workers). Starter pool tự tắt sau 20 phút idle.

front: Fabric Git integration providers
back: Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, cloud only. Mỗi workspace nối 1 branch và 1 folder.

front: Commit vs Update in Fabric source control
back: Commit pushes saved workspace changes to the branch; Update pulls new branch commits into the workspace. Save thôi thì chưa vào Git.

front: Isolated development per engineer with Git
back: Branch out to new workspace, then merge to the shared branch by pull request. Workspace chung là runtime dùng chung nên không đổi branch tuỳ ý.

front: Warehouse schema as code with reviewable deploy script
back: SDK-style SQL database project in VS Code, build .dacpac, publish with DacFx (Generate Script). Đang preview cho warehouse.

ref.label: Develop warehouse projects in VS Code

front: Deployment pipeline: is data copied between stages?
back: No, only metadata. Semantic model cần refresh sau deploy.

front: Deployment rule types
back: Data source and parameter rules (semantic model, dataflow Gen1), default lakehouse rule (notebook). Không tạo rule ở development stage; người tạo phải là owner item.

front: Stage-specific connections for pipelines
back: Variable library with value sets; each stage has its own active value set. Pipeline không có deployment rule.

front: Get the triggering file name in a pipeline
back: @pipeline()?.TriggerEvent?.FileName from a storage event trigger. Dấu ? tránh lỗi NULL khi chạy thủ công.

ref.label: Run, schedule, or use events to trigger a pipeline

front: runMultiple DAG defaults
back: timeoutInSeconds 43200 (12 hours), concurrency 3x CPU cores, timeoutPerCellInSeconds 90. Activity sau đọc kết quả bằng @activity('name').exitValue().
